_comment: Copy to config.local.json (git-ignored) and replace every <...> value. No secrets in this file: the Worker ingest secret lives in Windows Credential Manager under ingestCredentialTarget.
reportId: <numeric id of the saved report, from its admin URL>
_browserChannelComment: null = Playwright's bundled Chromium. Use "chrome" or "msedge" if the bundled build will not start on this PC.
_signInWaitComment: Minutes a headed run waits for a person to finish signing in (2FA) before giving up. 0-120.
_periodsComment: What a scheduled run collects (dates in timeZone). daily: kinds collected every run. monthlyOnDay: on this day of the month, also collect the previous full month.
